text: But who knows if it would be well received? What gamblers usually regret above all is less the loss of their money than of their foolish hopes. After all, I pity them less than the thousands of unfortunates to whom so much riches well-distributed would have been profitable, whilst for them they will be for ever barren.” I had no sooner expressed this regret than I felt that it must have wounded Captain Nemo. “Barren!” he exclaimed, with animation. “Do you think then, sir, that these riches are lost because I gather them?
